svg.title: Malpaco · Quiet map: no selection or visible text · phone-landscape
svg.desc: Quiet map: no selection or visible text. Revision 5, original static concept, not implemented or playtested. Vivid ownership; original wedge, elongated and broad-interior island forms with newly drawn province-like regions, inspired by real-world references without tracing. Portrait turns the same board 90 degrees. Quiet portrait is fitted; phone turn/capture show zoomed focus. Counts and action icons stay upright. Geography is not generation evidence. Contextual text clears when its interaction ends; required choices remain recoverable.
